Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in Step 2 by incorrectly identifying Norris Bradbury as the likely answer for the director of the Manhattan Project at Los Alamos. This misstep occurred despite historical evidence and widespread recognition that J. Robert Oppenheimer was the scientific director of the Manhattan Project at Los Alamos (Project Y). While the Planner later revised the understanding to focus on Oppenheimer, the initial error caused unnecessary iterations and confusion in subsequent steps, delaying the resolution of the problem.
